daas-irab:1-1.t: ﴿هَلْ أَتى﴾ an interrogative particle for arousing interest (tashwīq), and a past verb; and ﴿عَلَى الْإِنْسانِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and ﴿حِينٌ﴾ fāʿil (agent) of أتى; and ﴿مِنَ الدَّهْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of حين; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. And ﴿لَمْ يَكُنْ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lam, and its noun is latent (mustatir); and ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ khabar (predicate) of يكن; and ﴿مَذْكُوراً﴾ an adjective; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسانَ﴾ inna and its noun, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنا, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and ﴿مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and ﴿أَمْشاجٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of نطفة; and ﴿نَبْتَلِيهِ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). And ﴿فَجَعَلْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿سَمِيعاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿بَصِيراً﴾ an adjective; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿إِنَّا هَدَيْناهُ﴾ inna and its noun, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿السَّبِيلَ﴾ its second mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنا, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position; and ﴿إِمَّا﴾ a particle of condition and detailing (sharṭ wa-tafṣīl); and ﴿شاكِراً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَإِمَّا كَفُوراً﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنا﴾ inna and its noun, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنا, and the nominal clause is resumptive; and ﴿لِلْكافِرِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and ﴿سَلاسِلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَأَغْلالًا وَسَعِيراً﴾ both conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes them.

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿إِنَّ الْأَبْرارَ يَشْرَبُونَ﴾ inna and its noun, and an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); and ﴿مِنْ كَأْسٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause is resumptive; and ﴿كانَ مِزاجُها كافُوراً﴾ kāna, its noun and its predicate; the clause is an adjective of كأس.

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿عَيْناً﴾ badal (substitute) of كافورا; and ﴿يَشْرَبُ﴾ an imperfect verb; and ﴿بِها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and ﴿عِبادُ اللَّهِ﴾ fāʿil (agent), annexed to the Name of Majesty; the verbal clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of عينا; and ﴿يُفَجِّرُونَها﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿تَفْجِيراً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿يُوفُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); and ﴿بِالنَّذْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is resumptive; and ﴿وَيَخافُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; and ﴿يَوْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it; and ﴿كانَ شَرُّهُ مُسْتَطِيراً﴾ kāna, its noun and its predicate; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of يوما.

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿وَيُطْعِمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); and ﴿الطَّعامَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it; and ﴿عَلى حُبِّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and ﴿مِسْكِيناً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿يَتِيماً وَأَسِيراً﴾ both conjoined to what precedes them.

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿إِنَّما نُطْعِمُكُمْ﴾ restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa), and an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the object of an implied saying (maqūl qawl muqaddar); and ﴿لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and ﴿لا﴾ negative; and ﴿نُرِيدُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; and ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; and ﴿جَزاءً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلا﴾ negative; and ﴿شُكُوراً﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to جزاء.

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿إِنَّا نَخافُ﴾ inna and its noun, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); and ﴿مِنْ رَبِّنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and ﴿يَوْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿عَبُوساً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of يوما; and ﴿قَمْطَرِيراً﴾ a second adjective; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنا, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿فَوَقاهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a past verb and its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the Name of Majesty is fāʿil (agent); and ﴿شَرَّ ذلِكَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, annexed to the demonstrative; and ﴿الْيَوْمِ﴾ badal (substitute) of the demonstrative; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلَقَّاهُمْ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to فوقاهم. ﴿نَضْرَةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿سُرُوراً﴾ conjoined to نضرة.

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿وَجَزاهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it; and ﴿بِما صَبَرُوا﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition, and mā is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), and a past verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar formed from mā and the verb is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, and the preposition [with its genitive noun] is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and ﴿جَنَّةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿حَرِيراً﴾ conjoined to جنة.

daas-irab:13-13.t: ﴿مُتَّكِئِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb); and ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes them; and ﴿عَلَى الْأَرائِكِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in متكئين. And ﴿لا﴾ negative; and ﴿يَرَوْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); and ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; and ﴿شَمْساً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; and ﴿لا زَمْهَرِيراً﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to شمسا; the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:14-14.t: ﴿وَدانِيَةً﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to متكئين; and ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) دانية; and ﴿ظِلالُها﴾ fāʿil (agent) of دانية; and ﴿وَذُلِّلَتْ﴾ a passive past verb; and ﴿قُطُوفُها﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and ﴿تَذْلِيلًا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is conjoined to دانية.

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿وَيُطافُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb; and ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and ﴿بِآنِيَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; and ﴿مِنْ فِضَّةٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of آنية; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿وَأَكْوابٍ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿كانَتْ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is latent (mustatir); and ﴿قَوارِيرَا﴾ its khabar (predicate); the verbal clause is an adjective of أكواب.

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿قَوارِيرَا﴾ badal (substitute) of what precedes it; and ﴿مِنْ فِضَّةٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of قوارير; and ﴿قَدَّرُوها﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿تَقْدِيراً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:17-17.t: ﴿وَيُسْقَوْنَ﴾ a conjunction, and a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and ﴿كَأْساً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it; and ﴿كانَ مِزاجُها زَنْجَبِيلًا﴾ kāna, its noun and its predicate; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of كأسا.

daas-irab:18-18.t: ﴿عَيْناً﴾ badal (substitute) of زنجبيلا; and ﴿فِيها﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of عينا; and ﴿تُسَمَّى﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); and ﴿سَلْسَبِيلًا﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a second adjective of عينا.

daas-irab:19-19.t: ﴿وَيَطُوفُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); and ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and ﴿وِلْدانٌ﴾ fāʿil (agent); and ﴿مُخَلَّدُونَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of ولدان; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. And ﴿إِذا﴾ a conditional adverb of time that does not make jussive; and ﴿رَأَيْتَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation; and ﴿حَسِبْتَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿لُؤْلُؤاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿مَنْثُوراً﴾ an adjective of لؤلؤا; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:20-20.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; and ﴿إِذا﴾ a conditional adverb of time that does not make jussive; and ﴿رَأَيْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation; and ﴿ثَمَّ﴾ an adverb of place; and ﴿رَأَيْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; and ﴿نَعِيماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَمُلْكاً﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to نعيما; and ﴿كَبِيراً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:21-21.t: ﴿عالِيَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); and ﴿ثِيابُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), annexed to ﴿سُندُسٍ﴾; and ﴿خُضْرٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of ثياب; the nominal clause is resumptive; and ﴿إِسْتَبْرَقٌ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ثياب. ﴿وَحُلُّوا﴾ the wāw is of ḥāl (circumstantial), and a passive past verb and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and ﴿أَساوِرَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿مِنْ فِضَّةٍ﴾ an adjective of أساور; the clause is a ḥāl clause. ﴿وَسَقاهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its first mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿رَبُّهُمْ﴾ fāʿil (agent); and ﴿شَراباً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿طَهُوراً﴾ an adjective of شرابا; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:22-22.t: ﴿إِنَّ هذا كانَ﴾ inna and its noun, and a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is latent (mustatir); and ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). ﴿جَزاءً﴾ khabar; the clause of kāna is the khabar of inna, and the clause is the object of an omitted saying (maqūl qawl maḥdhūf). ﴿وَكانَ سَعْيُكُمْ مَشْكُوراً﴾ kāna, its noun and its predicate; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:23-23.t: ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun; and ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); and ﴿نَزَّلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنا, and the nominal clause is resumptive; and ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and ﴿الْقُرْآنَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿تَنْزِيلًا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

daas-irab:24-24.t: ﴿فَاصْبِرْ﴾ the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); and ﴿لِحُكْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. And ﴿وَلا تُطِعْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lā, whose fāʿil is latent; and ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; and ﴿آثِماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction; and ﴿كَفُوراً﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to آثما; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:25-25.t: ﴿وَاذْكُرِ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); and ﴿اسْمَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), annexed to ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بُكْرَةً﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿وَأَصِيلًا﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to بكرة; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:26-26.t: ﴿وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) اسجد; and ﴿فَاسْجُدْ﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); and ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; and ﴿وَسَبِّحْهُ﴾ an imperative verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it; and ﴿لَيْلًا﴾ an adverb of time; and ﴿طَوِيلًا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa).

daas-irab:27-27.t: ﴿إِنَّ هؤُلاءِ يُحِبُّونَ﴾ inna and its noun, and an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); and ﴿الْعاجِلَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl). ﴿وَيَذَرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿وَراءَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place; and ﴿يَوْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿ثَقِيلًا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of يوما; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:28-28.t: ﴿نَحْنُ خَلَقْناهُمْ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject), and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَشَدَدْنا أَسْرَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿وَإِذا﴾ a conditional adverb of time that does not make jussive; and ﴿شِئْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation; and ﴿بَدَّلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; and ﴿أَمْثالَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿تَبْدِيلًا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:29-29.t: Its i'rab has preceded in verse 19 of Sūrat al-Muzzammil.

daas-irab:30-30.t: ﴿وَما﴾ negative; and ﴿تَشاؤُنَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive; and ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ يَشاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation to an omitted adverb, i.e. «except at the time of Allah's willing»; and ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ﴾ inna and its noun, and a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is latent (mustatir); and ﴿عَلِيماً حَكِيماً﴾ two predicates (khabar); the verbal clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīliyya).

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿يُدْخِلُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); and ﴿مَنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; and ﴿فِي رَحْمَتِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿وَالظَّالِمِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being «He punishes» (يعذب); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it; and ﴿أَعَدَّ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; and ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; and ﴿عَذاباً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿أَلِيماً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is explicative (mufassira) of what precedes it.
